exec(r'''
import numpy as np, requests, pandas as pd
from collections import OrderedDict
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
AA3to1={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse_full(t):
    ca=OrderedDict(); allat=OrderedDict(); seen=set()
    for line in t.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
        if not (line.startswith("ATOM") or line.startswith("HETATM")): continue
        if line.startswith("HETATM") and line[17:20].strip()!="MSE": continue
        if line[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        rn=line[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3to1: continue
        c=line[21]; rid=line[22:27].strip(); nm=line[12:16].strip()
        xyz=[float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])]
        if not nm.startswith("H"): allat.setdefault(c,[]).append((rid,rn,nm,xyz))
        if nm=="CA":
            k=(c,line[22:27])
            if k in seen: continue
            seen.add(k)
            e=ca.setdefault(c,{"num":[],"seq":"","xyz":[]})
            e["num"].append(rid); e["seq"]+=AA3to1[rn]; e["xyz"].append(xyz)
    return {c:(v["num"],v["seq"],np.array(v["xyz"])) for c,v in ca.items()}, allat
URLS={"5FMR":"https://files.rcsb.org/download/5FMR.pdb","5FMS":"https://files.rcsb.org/download/5FMS.pdb",
"1JDB":"https://files.rcsb.org/download/1JDB.pdb","1GPM":"https://files.rcsb.org/download/1GPM.pdb",
"1I1Q":"https://files.rcsb.org/download/1I1Q.pdb",
"AF_G5EDF6":"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-G5EDF6-F1-model_v6.pdb",
"AF_Q9Y366":"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q9Y366-F1-model_v6.pdb",
"AF_Q99497":"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q99497-F1-model_v6.pdb"}
S={}; ATOMS={}
for k,u in URLS.items():
    r=requests.get(u,timeout=240); r.raise_for_status(); S[k],ATOMS[k]=parse_full(r.text)
def kabsch(Pp,Q):
    pc,qc=Pp.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(Pp-pc).T@(Q-qc); U,_,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))]); R=Vt.T@D@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc
def d0_of(L): return 0.5 if L<=15 else max(1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5)
def tm_opt(xa,xb,aln,Lnorm,full=True):
    if len(aln)<4: return 0.0,None,None,np.nan
    I=np.array([a[0] for a in aln]); J=np.array([a[1] for a in aln])
    A=xa[I]; B=xb[J]; d0=d0_of(Lnorm); L=len(aln); best=(-1,None,None)
    for Li in ([L,L//2,L//4,4] if full else [L]):
        if Li<4: continue
        for st in range(0,L-Li+1,max(1,Li//2)):
            idx=np.arange(st,st+Li)
            for _ in range(20):
                if len(idx)<4: break
                R,t=kabsch(A[idx],B[idx]); d=np.linalg.norm(A@R.T+t-B,axis=1)
                sc=(1/(1+(d/d0)**2)).sum()
                if sc>best[0]: best=(sc,R,t)
                cut=d0+1.0; ni=np.where(d<cut)[0]
                while len(ni)<4 and cut<20: cut+=0.5; ni=np.where(d<cut)[0]
                if len(ni)==len(idx) and np.all(ni==idx): break
                idx=ni
    sc,R,t=best; d=np.linalg.norm(A@R.T+t-B,axis=1)
    return sc/Lnorm,R,t,(float(np.sqrt((d[d<5]**2).mean())) if (d<5).any() else np.nan)
def dp_fast(s,g=-0.6):
    n,m=s.shape; F=np.empty((n+1,m+1)); F[0,:]=g*np.arange(m+1); F[:,0]=g*np.arange(n+1); jj=np.arange(1,m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        tmp=np.maximum(F[i-1,0:m]+s[i-1,:],F[i-1,1:m+1]+g)
        a=np.empty(m+1); a[0]=F[i,0]; a[1:]=tmp-g*jj
        F[i,1:]=g*jj+np.maximum.accumulate(a)[1:]
    i,j=n,m; aln=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j-1]+s[i-1,j-1]))<1e-9: aln.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j]+g))<1e-9: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return aln[::-1]
def tmalign(xa,xb,ntop=5,niter=10,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=len(xa),len(xb); Lnorm=min(n,m); d0=d0_of(Lnorm); cands=[]
    for off in range(-(n-20),m-20+1,3):
        lo=max(0,-off); hi=min(n,m-off)
        if hi-lo<20: continue
        I=np.arange(lo,hi); a=list(zip(I.tolist(),(I+off).tolist()))
        cands.append((tm_opt(xa,xb,a,Lnorm,full=False)[0],a))
    cands.sort(key=lambda z:-z[0]); best=(-1,None)
    for _,seed in cands[:ntop]:
        aln=seed
        for _ in range(niter):
            tm,R,t,_=tm_opt(xa,xb,aln,Lnorm,full=False)
            if R is None: break
            D=np.linalg.norm((xa@R.T+t)[:,None,:]-xb[None,:,:],axis=2)
            new=dp_fast(1/(1+(D/d0)**2),gap)
            if new==aln: break
            aln=new
        r=tm_opt(xa,xb,aln,Lnorm,full=True)
        if r[0]>best[0]: best=(r[0],(aln,r[1],r[2],r[3]))
    tm,(aln,R,t,rms)=best
    I=np.array([a[0] for a in aln]); J=np.array([a[1] for a in aln])
    return dict(tm=tm,aln=aln,R=R,t=t,rmsd=rms,Lali=len(aln),
                dist=np.linalg.norm(xa[I]@R.T+t-xb[J],axis=1))
def sub(st,chain,lo=None,hi=None):
    num,seq,xyz=S[st][chain]
    ints=np.array([int("".join(c for c in x if c.isdigit() or c=="-")) for x in num])
    m=np.ones(len(ints),bool)
    if lo is not None: m&=ints>=lo
    if hi is not None: m&=ints<=hi
    return dict(num=ints[m],seq="".join(np.array(list(seq))[m]),xyz=xyz[m],chain=chain,pdb=st,lo=lo,hi=hi)
P={"crIFT52_GIFT":sub("5FMR","A"),"mmIFT52_GIFT":sub("5FMS","A"),
   "ceOSM6_GIFT":sub("AF_G5EDF6","A",1,270),"hsIFT52_GIFT":sub("AF_Q9Y366","A",1,260),
   "CarA_GATase":sub("1JDB","C",193,380),"GuaA_GATase":sub("1GPM","A",1,207),
   "TrpG_GATase":sub("1I1Q","B",1,192),"DJ1":sub("AF_Q99497","A")}
def heavy(key):
    p=P[key]; lo,hi=p.get("lo"),p.get("hi"); out=[]
    for rid,rn,nm,xyz in ATOMS[p["pdb"]][p["chain"]]:
        try: n=int("".join(c for c in rid if c.isdigit() or c=="-"))
        except: continue
        if lo is not None and n<lo: continue
        if hi is not None and n>hi: continue
        out.append((n,rn,nm,np.array(xyz)))
    return out
''')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
PAIRS=[('crIFT52_GIFT','mmIFT52_GIFT'),('ceOSM6_GIFT','hsIFT52_GIFT'),('crIFT52_GIFT','ceOSM6_GIFT'),
       ('CarA_GATase','GuaA_GATase'),('CarA_GATase','TrpG_GATase'),('GuaA_GATase','TrpG_GATase'),
       ('ceOSM6_GIFT','CarA_GATase'),('ceOSM6_GIFT','GuaA_GATase'),('ceOSM6_GIFT','TrpG_GATase'),
       ('crIFT52_GIFT','CarA_GATase'),('DJ1','CarA_GATase'),('DJ1','GuaA_GATase')]
TM={p:tmalign(P[p[0]]['xyz'],P[p[1]]['xyz'])['tm'] for p in PAIRS}
carA=heavy('CarA_GATase')
def atom(at,a,b):
    for n,rn,nm,x in at:
        if n==a and nm==b: return x
ctr=np.mean([atom(carA,269,'SG'),atom(carA,353,'NE2'),atom(carA,355,'OE1')],axis=0)
QS=['TrpG_GATase','GuaA_GATase','DJ1','crIFT52_GIFT','mmIFT52_GIFT','ceOSM6_GIFT','hsIFT52_GIFT']
TR={}; ALN={}
for q in QS:
    r=tmalign(P[q]['xyz'],P['CarA_GATase']['xyz']); ALN[q]=r
    m={int(P['CarA_GATase']['num'][j]):(int(P[q]['num'][i]),i) for i,j in r['aln']}
    row={}
    for lab,rn in [('Cys269',269),('His353',353),('Glu355',355)]:
        row[lab]=(P[q]['seq'][m[rn][1]],m[rn][0]) if rn in m else ('-',None)
    row['_ctx']=P[q]['seq'][max(0,m[269][1]-4):m[269][1]+5] if 269 in m else ''
    TR[q]=row
DIRS=np.array([np.array([a,b,c])/np.linalg.norm([a,b,c]) for a in(-1,0,1) for b in(-1,0,1) for c in(-1,0,1) if a or b or c])
def cavity(coords,centre,box=8.0,sp=0.75,probe=1.4,vdw=1.8,bc=0.72):
    tr=cKDTree(coords); g=np.arange(-box,box+1e-9,sp)
    G=np.stack(np.meshgrid(g,g,g,indexing='ij'),-1).reshape(-1,3)+centre
    G=G[np.linalg.norm(G-centre,axis=1)<=box]
    d,_=tr.query(G); Gf=G[d>(probe+vdw)]
    if not len(Gf): return 0.0
    bur=np.zeros(len(Gf)); steps=np.arange(2.0,14.1,1.0)
    for u in DIRS:
        dd,_=tr.query((Gf[:,None,:]+u*steps[:,None]).reshape(-1,3))
        bur+=(dd.reshape(len(Gf),len(steps))<vdw+0.4).any(1)
    return float(((bur/len(DIRS))>bc).sum()*sp**3)
CAV={'CarA_GATase':cavity(np.array([x for _,_,_,x in carA]),ctr)}
for k in QS:
    co=np.array([x for _,_,_,x in heavy(k)]); r=ALN[k]
    CAV[k]=cavity(co,(ctr-r['t'])@r['R'])

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,9.5)); gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.0],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.24)
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
groups=[("IFT52 vs IFT52 (ortholog control)",PAIRS[0:3],'#2f6f9f'),
        ("GATase vs GATase (catalytic control)",PAIRS[3:6],'#1f8a5f'),
        ("IFT52 GIFT vs class-I GATase",PAIRS[6:10],'#c4622d'),
        ("DJ-1 vs GATase (fold-only control)",PAIRS[10:12],'#7a5ba6')]
x=0;xt=[];xl=[]
for lab,prs,col in groups:
    for a,b in prs:
        axA.bar(x,TM[(a,b)],color=col,width=0.75)
        axA.text(x,TM[(a,b)]+0.012,f"{TM[(a,b)]:.2f}",ha='center',fontsize=7.5)
        xt.append(x); xl.append(f"{a.split('_')[0]} / {b.split('_')[0]}"); x+=1
    x+=0.8
axA.axhline(0.5,ls='--',c='0.45',lw=1); axA.text(0.1,0.52,'TM = 0.5, same fold',fontsize=7.5,color='0.35')
axA.set_xticks(xt); axA.set_xticklabels(xl,rotation=55,ha='right',fontsize=7)
axA.set_ylabel('TM-score (normalised by shorter chain)'); axA.set_ylim(0,1.02)
axA.set_title('A  The GIFT domain has the class-I GATase fold',fontsize=11,loc='left')
for lab,prs,col in groups: axA.scatter([],[],color=col,label=lab,s=55,marker='s')
axA.legend(fontsize=6.6,loc='upper right',frameon=False)

axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1]); axB.axis('off')
L={'TrpG_GATase':'TrpG anthranilate synth II (1I1Q)','GuaA_GATase':'GuaA GMP synthase (1GPM)','DJ1':'DJ-1 / PARK7 (AF)',
 'crIFT52_GIFT':'IFT52 C. reinhardtii (5FMR)','mmIFT52_GIFT':'IFT52 M. musculus (5FMS)',
 'ceOSM6_GIFT':'OSM-6 C. elegans (AF G5EDF6)','hsIFT52_GIFT':'IFT52 H. sapiens (AF Q9Y366)'}
axB.text(0,1.02,'B  Residue structurally equivalent to each E. coli CarA catalytic residue',fontsize=11,va='top')
axB.text(0,0.93,f"{'structure':32s}{'Cys269':>9s}{'His353':>9s}{'Glu355':>9s}   nucleophile elbow",family='monospace',fontsize=8.3,va='top')
y=0.855
for q in QS:
    r=TR[q]; ok=all(r[k][0]==k[0] for k in ('Cys269','His353','Glu355'))
    axB.text(0,y,f"{L[q][:31]:32s}"+"".join(f"{(r[k][0]+str(r[k][1])):>9s}" for k in ('Cys269','His353','Glu355'))+"   "+r['_ctx'],
             family='monospace',fontsize=8.3,color='#1f8a5f' if ok else '#c4622d',va='top')
    y-=0.085
axB.text(0,y-0.02,'green: all three catalytic residues retained.  orange: substituted.',fontsize=7.8,color='0.35',va='top')
axB.text(0,y-0.10,'Unbiased geometric scan (SG..His-N < 5.0 A and His-N..acid-O < 3.6 A):\n'
                  '  triad found  -> CarA C269-H353-E355, GuaA C86-H181-E183, TrpG C83-H169-E171\n'
                  '  no triad     -> all four IFT52 GIFT domains, and DJ-1',fontsize=8.1,va='top',family='monospace')

axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
ks=['CarA_GATase','GuaA_GATase','TrpG_GATase','DJ1','crIFT52_GIFT','mmIFT52_GIFT','ceOSM6_GIFT','hsIFT52_GIFT']
cols=['#1f8a5f']*3+['#7a5ba6']+['#c4622d']*4
axC.bar(range(len(ks)),[CAV[k] for k in ks],color=cols)
for i,k in enumerate(ks): axC.text(i,CAV[k]+1.0,f"{CAV[k]:.0f}",ha='center',fontsize=8)
axC.set_xticks(range(len(ks))); axC.set_xticklabels([k.replace('_GATase','').replace('_GIFT','') for k in ks],rotation=45,ha='right',fontsize=8)
axC.set_ylabel(r'buried cavity volume ($\AA^3$)')
axC.set_title('C  A buried cavity persists where the active site was',fontsize=11,loc='left')
axC.text(0.03,0.96,'probe-accessible, buried grid volume within 8 A of the CarA\ncatalytic centroid mapped into each frame by the superposition',
         transform=axC.transAxes,fontsize=7.3,va='top',color='0.35')

axD=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
r=ALN['ceOSM6_GIFT']; qn=[int(P['ceOSM6_GIFT']['num'][i]) for i,j in r['aln']]
axD.plot(qn,r['dist'],lw=1.2,color='#c4622d',label='OSM-6 GIFT vs CarA GATase (TM=%.2f)'%r['tm'])
r2=tmalign(P['ceOSM6_GIFT']['xyz'],P['crIFT52_GIFT']['xyz'])
qn2=[int(P['ceOSM6_GIFT']['num'][i]) for i,j in r2['aln']]
axD.plot(qn2,r2['dist'],lw=1.2,color='#2f6f9f',label='OSM-6 GIFT vs crIFT52 5FMR (TM=%.2f)'%r2['tm'])
axD.axhline(4,ls='--',c='0.6',lw=0.9)
for lab in ('Cys269','His353','Glu355'):
    rn=TR['ceOSM6_GIFT'][lab][1]
    if rn:
        axD.axvline(rn,color='0.5',ls=':',lw=1)
        axD.text(rn,axD.get_ylim()[1]*0.97,f"{lab[:3]} site\n{TR['ceOSM6_GIFT'][lab][0]}{rn}",rotation=0,fontsize=7,ha='center',va='top',color='0.3')

axD.set_title('D  OSM-6 follows the GATase fold across the GIFT domain',fontsize=11,loc='left')

fig.suptitle('OSM-6/IFT52 GIFT domain keeps the class-I glutamine amidotransferase fold but not its catalytic triad',fontsize=13,y=0.985)
plt.show()
